caption: The drawing depicts a vertical, metallic cross standing atop a multi-tiered, rounded red base. The cross is silver or grey in color, with shading to indicate metallic texture and contours, and features a circular central joint where the arms meet the upright segment. Just below the intersection, a domed, metallic component transitions to an array of pointed, elongated triangular shapes that hang downward in a skirt-like fashion, also rendered in a silvery color. These metallic pointed shapes sit directly above the red base, which has three bulbous, stacked layers, colored in varying shades of red and maroon, with shading to indicate dimensionality. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there are faint shadows cast behind and to the side of the base, giving the drawing a sense of depth. The words "full size" are handwritten in the lower left corner of the page.
title: Crucifix
